definitions.explanation: A pyramid with a quadrilateral base (typically a square or rectangle) and four triangular faces meeting at an apex. A standard solid figure introduced in middle-school geometry, familiar as the shape of the Pyramids of Giza.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{四角|しかく}→四角：02836_shikaku⟧ (quadrilateral, square) and {錐|すい} (cone, pointed solid). The suffix {錐|すい} is used productively in geometric terms for pyramids and cones.

USAGE:
A technical term in geometry, appearing mainly in math textbooks, lesson materials, and science writing. Like most Japanese geometric-solid names, it is formed with a base-shape name plus {錐|すい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四角錐|しかくすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体積|たいせき}→体積：04492_taiseki⟧: volume of a square pyramid
- {四角錐|しかくすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表面積|ひょうめんせき}→表面積：28898_hyoumenseki⟧: surface area of a square pyramid
- {四角錐|しかくすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{展開図|てんかいず}: net (unfolded diagram) of a square pyramid
- {正四角錐|せいしかくすい}: right square pyramid (with a square base and apex directly above the center)

RELATED GEOMETRIC SOLIDS:
- ⟦{三角錐|さんかくすい}→三角錐：29329_sankakusui⟧: triangular pyramid, tetrahedron
- ⟦{円錐|えんすい}→円錐：05550_ensui⟧: cone (circular base)
- ⟦{角錐|かくすい}→角錐：28896_kakusui⟧: pyramid (general term)
- {四角柱|しかくちゅう}: rectangular prism — the prism counterpart to {四角錐|しかくすい}
- ⟦{立方体|りっぽうたい}→立方体：05549_rippoutai⟧: cube — another common solid figure
